name: Testament Legacy
source: Testament Legacy is a two-parts VN set in a harsh 2491. It tells the story of a group of soldiers trying to unveil the mystery surrounding dangerous creatures simply known as red-eyes. The setting is a cool blend of different well-established genres, like post-apocalyptic, Sci-Fi, and Cyberpunk. To sum it in one single sentence, it's "The rise and fall of mankind".
translation: 《Testament Legacy》是一部由上下两部分组成的视觉小说，故事设定在残酷的2491年。一群士兵试图揭开围绕危险生物“红眼”展开的谜团。世界观融合了末世、科幻与赛博朋克等多种成熟类型的元素。若要用一句话概括，那就是“人类的兴衰”。
